meta.homeTitle: Transcript, averages and calendar for university students
meta.homeDescription: Studentplat is the online transcript for university students: record your exams and grades, get your arithmetic and credit-weighted averages, follow your grade trend and plan your study days.

site.home: Studentplat, go to the home page

hero.title: Your university transcript, with the maths already done.
hero.lead: Record the exams you've passed and the ones still ahead. Studentplat works out your arithmetic and credit-weighted averages and shows you how your grades are trending.

sample.caption: Sample transcript with three exams
sample.note: In the average, 30 cum laude counts as 31.

transcript.title: Exam transcript
transcript.text: Every exam with its credits and grade, from 18 to 30 cum laude. Exams you haven't taken yet stay on your list until you record them.

average.title: Arithmetic and weighted average
average.text: Both averages update with every new grade. The weighted average counts each exam by its credits, just as your university does.

chart.title: Grade trend
chart.text: A chart lines up your grades in the order you got them, so you can see whether you're improving.

calendar.title: Study and exam calendar
calendar.text: Mark your exam session dates and the days you set aside for studying, and see what's coming up over the next few weeks.

catalog.title: Shared exam catalogue
catalog.text: When a student creates an exam, its name and credits become available to everyone: add it to your transcript without typing it all again.

account.title: Create your account
account.text: All it takes is a name, an email and a password.

profile.title: Add your degree
profile.text: Degree programme, university and total credits, so you know how far you are from graduating.

exams.title: Add exams and grades
exams.text: Pick exams from the catalogue or create new ones, then record your grade once you've taken them.

cta.title: Start with your next exam
cta.text: Signing up is free, and only you can see your grades.

footer.text: Studentplat, the online transcript for university students.
footer.credits: Made by {name}, Computer Science and Technology student

auth.tagline: Keep track of exams, study days, grades and averages in one place.
